purpose: Turn the HTTPS production panel from a mostly static/readmodel shell into a living command center by binding each center to explicit readmodel contracts.

current_truth.panel_engine_flow: Engine -> ReadModel -> Public Bridge -> Active Panel -> Domain

binding_principle: Panel must never invent state. Every visible tile must declare source file, freshness, producer, authority, and stale behavior.

command_center.first_goal: Show system readiness, top alerts, and bridge health.

news_center.first_goal: Display SEALED_INACTIVE until news runtime is repaired and fresh.

onchain_center.first_goal: Show available lookup-only candidates and data binding status.

whale_center.first_goal: Display DATA_MISSING until whale runtime exists.

technical_center.first_goal: Display DATA_MISSING until TA runtime exists.

risk_center.first_goal: Separate preview risk text from live risk evidence.

lifecycle_center.first_goal: Display DATA_MISSING until lifecycle runtime exists.

system_center.first_goal: Show local/remote sync, HTTPS status, panel status, sealed inactive branches.

implementation_order: N16A create panel_live_manifest_v1.json with 8 center contracts
N16B create noapi readmodel builder that writes placeholder truthful DATA_MISSING or READY states
N16C bind panel index to panel_live_manifest_v1.json without removing existing cards
N16D promote real producers center-by-center only after proof
